Release Fine-Tuned Models as a Suite

Source: R/fine_tune.R
resolve.derive_suite.Rd

Release checkpoints fine-tuned from a suite's members (see resolve.parent()) as a model suite of their own, which resolve.load_suite() and resolve.predict.suite() read like any other. Each checkpoint is copied into dir, and the manifest written beside them takes its input contract from the parent suite (the part of it the targets' members read), names for each target the parent suite and target its members started from, with that suite's licence and training scope, and records per member the SHA-256 of its parent checkpoint, which the checkpoint records too. The manifest is sealed and the suite loaded once, so every member is checked against it.

Usage

resolve.derive_suite(
  dir,
  parent,
  name,
  licence,
  trainingScope,
  targets,
  description = ""
)

Arguments

dir

Directory the suite is written to; must not hold a manifest yet.

parent

Path of the suite directory the members were fine-tuned from.

name

The suite's name.

licence

The licence the suite is released under.

trainingScope

The plots the fine-tuned members were trained on.

targets

A named list with one element per target, named by the target: a list with members, a named vector or list of checkpoint paths named by their seed (c("1" = "seed1.pt", "2" = "seed2.pt")), and optionally outputs (the heads read; default the head named as the target), combine ("vote", "mean", "circular_mean", "spherical_mean"; default a vote for a classification head, a mean for a regression head), period, units, status ("released" or "experimental"), limit (required for an experimental target), training and validation (named lists recorded as they are).

description

What the suite imputes.

Value

The manifest written, as a nested list, invisibly.

Examples

source(system.file("examples", "habitat-suite.R", package = "resolveR"))
resolve.seal_suite(suite_dir)
parent <- resolve.parent(suite_dir, target = "habitat", seed = 1L)
tuned <- resolve.dataset.csv(plots, species, roles = roles,
                             targets = list(elevation = list(column = "elevation",
                                                             task = "regression")),
                             vocabs = parent$vocabs(), config = parent$dataset_config())
path <- file.path(tempdir(), "elevation_seed1.pt")
fit <- resolve.train.dataset(tuned, initFrom = parent, freezeEncoder = TRUE,
                             maxEpochs = 20L, savePath = path, verbose = FALSE)
derived <- file.path(tempdir(), "elevation_suite")
unlink(derived, recursive = TRUE)
manifest <- resolve.derive_suite(derived, parent = suite_dir, name = "elevation_example",
                                 licence = "CC-BY-4.0",
                                 trainingScope = "150 synthetic Alpine plots",
                                 targets = list(elevation = list(members = c("1" = path),
                                                                 units = "m")))
manifest$targets[[1]]$derived_from$target
